CFML Language Reference: Functions

KFUSION_CHECKSYNTAX

Parses a string of CFML exactly as the server would parse a template, but does not execute it. Returns a structure telling you whether the code is valid and, if not, what is wrong and where.

Category

Other functions

Syntax

KFUSION_CHECKSYNTAX(code [, name ])

Parameters

code
The CFML source to check.
name
Optional template name used in the error message. Defaults to "(pasted code)".

Returns

A structure with the keys OK (YES or NO), Message, Detail, Line and Column. For valid code the Message is "No syntax errors were found." and Line and Column are 0.

Usage

This is a KoldFusion extension, not part of CFML 4.5; code that uses it will not run on other servers. It is the engine behind the CFML Syntax Checker at /CFDOCS/cfmlsyntaxcheck/cfmlsyntaxcheck.cfm, the place to go when you would rather point and click.

Unlike the other KFUSION_ functions, which are reserved for the Administrator and fail elsewhere, KFUSION_CHECKSYNTAX works in any template. It finds only errors the parser can see, such as a missing end tag or a malformed expression; misspelled variable names and runtime problems show up only when the page runs. The Message may contain HTML.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Samples = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Samples[1] = '<CFIF Speed GT 28800>Fast!</CFIF>'>
<CFSET Samples[2] = '<CFIF Speed GT 28800>Fast!'>
<CFSET Samples[3] = '<CFSET Total = (Price * 2>'>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Code</TH><TH>OK</TH><TH>Line:Col</TH><TH>Message</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Samples)#">
  <CFSET Check = KFUSION_CHECKSYNTAX(Samples[i], "sample#i#.cfm")>
  <CFOUTPUT><TR VALIGN="top"><TD><TT>#HTMLEditFormat(Samples[i])#</TT></TD><TD>#Check.OK#</TD>
  <TD>#Check.Line#:#Check.Column#</TD><TD>#Check.Message#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
